pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with highly serrated, non-smooth edge gradients. Individual patches show high spatial area dominance compared to the interstitial network.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways with frequent tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness is narrow and relatively uniform across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, bristled mane along the cervical ridge with low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations visible against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Significant structural gap at the dorsal-cervical junction characterized by a localized absence of mane hair and a downward indentation in the 1D silhouette.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Large localized area of textural disruption and de-pigmentation on the upper shoulder and dorsal hump, characterized by a thickened, greyish-brown plaque-like appearance.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive dermatological lesion on the dorsal ridge and shoulder area, showing localized loss of hair and altered skin texture.
